programme.title: Namastey London
programme.desc: On a trip to India, Jasmeet's father forcefully marries her off to Arjun. However, when they return to London, Jasmeet announces her intention of marrying her boyfriend, Charlie Brown.

programme.title: Sultaan
programme.desc: Don Kabira helps Ayesha in saving her garage from local goons and hides the fact that he once used to be an honest inspector. However, Ayesha decides to find out the reason for his transformation.

programme.title: Kya Dil Ne Kahaa
programme.desc: Esha and Rahul fall for each other and decide to get married with the approval of their parents. However, much to her shock, he refuses her proposal when her parents come to meet him.

programme.title: Sawan Ki Ghata
programme.desc: A man arranges his daughter's marriage to prevent her from marrying the man who truly loves her.

programme.title: Sheesha
programme.desc: Dinesh and Maneesha fall in love and, soon after, get married. However, things get complicated for the newly-wed couple as Poonam, Dinesh's colleague files a serious case against him.

programme.title: Haye Mera Dil
programme.desc: Sangeeta, a renowned dancer, leads a luxurious life. However, she is unaware that the man who claims to be her father is actually a criminal who abducted her years ago.

programme.title: Bairaag
programme.desc: Manservant Bhola is secretly in love with his master's granddaughter but she is set to wed another. But the dowry-demanding groom absconds with the money and Bhola is sent to bring him back.

programme.title: Virasat
programme.desc: Watch award-winning performances by Anil Kapoor and Tabu in this story of a dutiful son who sacrifices all his happiness to live his father's dream of developing his native village.

programme.title: Ahankaar
programme.desc: Prabhat loses his voice in a freak accident while trying to save his stepmother. However, this sacrifice and many others go unappreciated by a family largely filled with selfish and unethical people.

programme.title: Lanka
programme.desc: Jaswant, an influential gangster, loves his mistress but keeps her captive and refuses to marry her. However, his most-trusted protege decides to go against him and plans to free her.

programme.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 1
programme.desc: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life. (1/5)

programme.title: Majhdhaar
programme.desc: Krishna loves Radha but they cannot marry against their parent's wishes. Although she is pregnant with Krishna's child, circumstances lead Radha to marry Gopal.

programme.title: Dil E Nadaan
programme.desc: Unaware of each other's feelings, thick pals Vikram and Anand fall for the same woman. However, an unexpected incident changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Kya Dil Ne Kahaa
programme.desc: Esha and Rahul fall for each other and decide to get married with the approval of their parents. However, much to her shock, he refuses her proposal when her parents come to meet him.

programme.title: Style
programme.desc: Best friends Bantu and Chantu try make two wealthy girls fall in love with them. However, they find out that the girls have been murdered and become prime suspects.

programme.title: Izzat
programme.desc: An honest cop is framed for a murder when he starts investigating a scam. However, he manages to escape from prison and goes undercover as a woman to unravel the conspiracy.

programme.title: Ek Chalis Ki Last Local
programme.desc: A comic thriller about two people who miss the last local train at 1:40 am and how missing of their train changes their course of life forever.

programme.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 2
programme.desc: Rajkummar Rao, one of the most talented and versatile actors today, talks about his being an outsider to the industry, the different shades of unique characters he plays and his success. (1/2)

programme.title: Shola Aur Shabnam

programme.desc: Tashi, Nitin and Arup, three strugglers who are also roommates, unknowingly become the target of a powerful gangster when they misplace his expensive diamonds.
